qa.complaint_resolution_evidence: Cycle-6 close-NO specifically blocked on §5.3.D bullet 5 (final_summary in subagent lifecycle card not reaching production). Cycle 7 three-layer fix: (1) bridge codexAppServerClient.ts:476 forwards `agentsStates` on item/completed (was asymmetric — only on item/started before); (2) mapper sessionProtocolMapper.ts:649-658 deletes hallucinated `message.final_summary`/`finalSummary` reads, calls new `readAgentsStatesMessage()` helper that walks the real Codex protocol path `event.agentsStates[receiverThreadId].message`, buffers on wait_agent end, emits terminal envelope on close_agent end (idempotent; close-only branch); (3) orchestrator runCodex.ts:289,622,627 declares `codexSubagentLifecycles` Map, passes through state object, captures returned Map — so the buffer survives across mapper invocations within a turn (cycle-6 dev's mapper would have produced nothing in production because state.subagentLifecycles was undefined and getSubagentLifecycles returned a fresh empty Map every event). Vitest 25/25 mapper + 16/16 bridge tests pass with real-shape protocol fixtures. Live DOM at localhost:8097/dev/codex-render-fixtures shows the merged lifecycle card with final_summary text rendering correctly on both desktop and mobile.
